title: CANVAS / CAPTURE / RECONSTRUCT / WEAR
asset_strategy: Lead with the source painting, then move through reconstruction evidence, then finish on a body-led product hero. Use ADRIFT_colour_oilpaint_v5.png as the origin, 4DRFT_design2_blacktext_FINAL copy.png for system translation, and JRR_4004.jpg / JRR_4010.jpg for the wearable proof. Keep each slide sparse, premium, and legible as an archive sequence.

slides.headline: SEVEN DESIGNS.
slides.notes: Treat as evidence, not decoration. Bone field, severe crop, maximum source presence.

slides.headline: CAPTURE
slides.notes: Show the extraction stage. Close, technical, quiet; let the raw process feel intentional.

slides.headline: RECONSTRUCT
slides.notes: Pair artwork logic with the graphic system. Use a stark split and preserve negative space.

slides.headline: FRAGMENT
slides.notes: Introduce the garment as a desirable object first. Strong body presence, oversized silhouette, premium light.

slides.headline: WORN
slides.notes: End on lifestyle proof. Candid movement, concrete/metal context, product-as-identity.

caption:
